levels.1: Begin with the first campaign in the collection.
levels.2: Use the Super Famicom Kyuuyaku Megami Tensei release and select Megami Tensei I.
levels.3: Run a legally dumped Kyuuyaku Megami Tensei cartridge through the selected Super Famicom route. Start the first campaign, record the ROM region and translation-patch version if one is used, and keep the eventual carry-over file for the second campaign.

levels.1: Build one sturdy attacker and one reliable caster.
levels.2: Spend the fifteen opening points for each protagonist before entering the dungeon.
levels.3: Give the male lead enough Strength for physical equipment checks and put the female lead's emphasis on Intelligence without neglecting survival. The hidden sword later tests the male lead's combined Strength, Intelligence, and Luck, so do not create a permanently lopsided file.

levels.1: Check every branch before using the next major route.
levels.2: Walk every accessible square on every fixed floor and revisit doors after gaining their keys.
levels.3: Use the automap as the ledger: fill ordinary corridors, dead ends, transporters, pits, damaging passages, locked rooms, and newly opened shortcuts. Before leaving an area permanently, compare each floor against its reachable boundary and mark any sealed branch for a later return.

levels.1: Several exchanges consume resources or alter the sequel file.
levels.2: Keep separate saves before the cash-doubling reward, all-Macca trade, unsealing ritual, and final transfer.
levels.3: Maintain at least three rotating files. Protect one before claiming Bien's cash multiplier, another before buying the Silver Relief, and a third before the three-gem ritual. Preserve both a pre-clear file and the transferred clear data for Megami Tensei II.

areas.name: Daedalus Tower
areas.location_cue: A descending stone tower with an elevator, shops, and branching rooms.
areas.note: Fixed locations and mechanical prerequisites only; story context is intentionally withheld.

levels.1: Search the opening floor before descending.
levels.2: Open the fixed chest on Daedalus 8F.
levels.3: Take the 500 Macca and Jewel before buying starter gear; the money is enough to establish the first equipment baseline.

levels.1: A particular early recruit opens a later path.
levels.2: Recruit Cerberus from Daedalus 1F.
levels.3: Negotiate with Cerberus on 1F and keep it available. The underworld entrance will not open without this ally, and the game later removes it temporarily.

levels.1: An odd encounter points toward a missing possession.
levels.2: Inspect the southwest room on Daedalus 3F.
levels.3: Challenge the disguised figure rather than paying it off. After the reveal, exhaust the conversation to learn the clue needed for Garu's missing shield.

levels.1: The lowest floor holds both a relic and a transport upgrade.
levels.2: Clear the fixed encounter on Daedalus 1F.
levels.3: Defeat the floor guardian around level 10 while maintaining healing and a recruited front line. Collect the Silence Gem afterward; it also activates the tower elevator.

levels.1: Return to an upper floor after learning about a guard's loss.
levels.2: After speaking with Garu, search Daedalus 3F beyond the elevator route.
levels.3: Speak to Garu at Bien's western entrance first, then use Daedalus's elevator to reach 3F and collect Garu's Shield. Return it to open the settlement route.

levels.1: Someone on the first floor carries a useful key.
levels.2: Speak with the old man near the east-center of Bien 1F.
levels.3: Exhaust the old man's dialogue to receive the Small Key. Keep it until the northwest room on the floor above has been opened.

levels.1: Prepare against a dangerous status effect.
levels.2: Use the Small Key in Bien 2F's northwest section.
levels.3: Cross the damaging tiles, unlock the northwest chamber, and take the Tabasa Statue. Merely owning it blocks the fourth-floor guardian's petrification attack.

levels.1: The upper floor controls the settlement's remaining doors.
levels.2: Clear the fixed encounter on Bien 4F while carrying the Tabasa Statue.
levels.3: Bring the statue, defeat the guardian, and collect the Bull Key. Without the statue the encounter remains possible but needlessly exposes the party to petrification.

levels.1: Delay one reward until your wallet is full.
levels.2: Use the Bull Key in Bien 2F's southeast quarter and meet its elder.
levels.3: Before speaking to the elder, hold as much Macca as practical. The reward includes the Excursion Ticket and adds twice your current cash, so claiming it with a nearly empty wallet wastes the one-time multiplier.

levels.1: Revisit the guard after restoring access.
levels.2: Return to Garu at Bien's western entrance after the fourth-floor encounter.
levels.3: Speak to Garu again and accept Loru's Talisman. Carry it into Valhalla; it disables the next guardian's magic and prevents an avoidable difficulty spike.

levels.1: Save two gems for the specialist shop.
levels.2: At Bien's Rag shop, complete two Amethyst exchanges.
levels.3: Exchange Amethysts for the Ares Necklace and the Magatama of Heaven. Both feed the later statue puzzle, and completing two trades also unlocks a separate transfer item.

levels.1: The gem shop remembers repeat customers.
levels.2: Claim the bonus after two exchanges at Bien's Rag shop.
levels.3: Finish two distinct gem trades, then speak to the shopkeeper again for the Members Card. Preserve it through the campaign transfer; it unlocks a hidden meeting in Megami Tensei II.

levels.1: A detector reveals a late return path in Bien.
levels.2: Return to Bien 4F with Loose's Bottle and follow the hidden drop route.
levels.3: Use the detector to find the concealed wall, follow the holes to the sword chamber, and attempt the pull with the male lead's Strength, Intelligence, and Luck totaling at least 48. If the check fails, raise those stats and return.

levels.1: Bring the guard's talisman through the corridor.
levels.2: Clear Valhalla's fixed 2F encounter with Loru's Talisman in inventory.
levels.3: Carry the talisman so the guardian's magic is sealed, finish the encounter, and take the Rough Gem. It is one component of the later three-position unsealing ritual.

levels.1: A paid detour returns more than it costs.
levels.2: Use Cerberus at Valhalla B1's odor point, then pay the zombie 500 Macca.
levels.3: Open the lower route with Cerberus, pay 500 Macca at the blocking encounter, and continue to the fixed chest. It contains 3,000 Macca and 1,000 Magnetite, producing a clear net gain.

levels.1: Make room before rescuing the trapped ally.
levels.2: Reach Rick on Valhalla B1 with fewer than seven demons in stock.
levels.3: Reduce demon stock below seven before the rescue. The event grants Rick's Bracelet and transforms him into a recruitable ally; a full stock prevents the transformation from joining, so reload if the slot check fails.

levels.1: An early ally leaves after the lower detour.
levels.2: Return to Daedalus 1F after exiting the underworld.
levels.3: Cerberus departs when the lower passage ends. Negotiate with it again on Daedalus 1F before continuing so later party and route plans do not assume a missing ally.

levels.3: Take the fixed Silk Thread and do not discard or exchange it. Carry it into the unsealing chamber and hand it over there so the transferred Megami Tensei II file can yield an extra protective item.

levels.1: Empty your wallet before a mandatory trade.
levels.2: Meet Gaia on Mazurka 8F to obtain the Silver Relief.
levels.3: Spend spare Macca on permanent equipment first, then accept Gaia's price: every coin currently held. The Silver Relief opens the concealed route on 3F; buying it with a full wallet destroys unnecessary funds.

levels.1: Two gem-shop relics combine at a fixed altar.
levels.2: Use the Ares Necklace and Heaven Magatama on Mazurka 5F.
levels.3: Bring both Rag-shop relics to the fifth-floor altar and complete the exchange for the Statue of Latose. Keep it for the third-floor guardian because it makes that target physically vulnerable.

levels.1: A hidden third-floor route needs two preparations.
levels.2: Use the Silver Relief on Mazurka 3F and carry the Statue of Latose.
levels.3: Reveal the sealed passage with the relief, bring the statue into the fixed encounter, and defeat the manifested guardian. Collect the Stirring Gem, the third ritual component.

levels.1: Three gems belong in three distinct positions.
levels.2: At the Sea of Flames B2 seal, place Rough on the forehead, Silence in the right eye, and Stirring in the left eye.
levels.3: Insert Rough Gem at the forehead, Silence Gem in the right eye, then Stirring Gem in the left eye. Confirm each placement before selecting the next; the correct order completes the unsealing and consumes the gems.

levels.1: A wrong placement is recoverable, but not immediately.
levels.2: After a failed B2 ritual, return to the entrance and advance the moon cycle.
levels.3: If the seal ejects the party, leave the chamber and walk until the moon phase changes enough for re-entry. Reloading the pre-ritual save is faster and preserves supplies.

levels.1: Carry the western-approach keepsake into the seal room.
levels.2: Have the Silk Thread in inventory when completing the B2 unsealing.
levels.3: Bring the thread through the successful ritual and accept the handoff prompt. This action is easy to miss and is required for the related bonus on the transferred second-campaign file.

levels.1: The successful ritual grants protection from the environment.
levels.2: Complete the B2 unsealing in the correct three-gem order.
levels.3: After the seal opens, receive Izanami's Clothes. Keep them in inventory to cancel damage from hazardous floors and wall impacts throughout this region.

levels.1: A side chamber contains a false-wall detector.
levels.2: Search the Sea of Flames 1F side rooms.
levels.3: Collect Loose's Bottle on 1F and retain it. When Mapper marks a suspicious wall, the bottle confirms hidden mechanisms and enables the return route to Bien's best weapon.

levels.1: One upper-floor encounter grants a defensive charm.
levels.2: Clear the fixed encounter on the Sea of Flames 2F.
levels.3: Defeat Purski and take Purski's Neigh. Carrying it nullifies the physical attacks of the guardian below, making that optional equipment reward much safer.

levels.1: Bring the neigh charm to the first floor.
levels.2: Clear the Sea of Flames 1F guardian while carrying Purski's Neigh.
levels.3: Keep the charm in inventory, defeat Set after its physical attacks are suppressed, and collect the Lion Shield. This is the strongest shield and cannot be bought.

levels.1: A remote vase only responds after a palace clue.
levels.2: Return to the Sea of Flames 2F with Rick's Bracelet after hearing the Infini 4F clue.
levels.3: Inspect the bottomless vase with both the dialogue flag and Rick's Bracelet active. Retrieve the White Dragon Gem; carrying it prevents the final guardian from using its major healing technique.
